description: Approved npm audit exceptions, evaluated by scripts/audit-policy.mjs (CI frontend job, step 'Full dependency audit'). Each exception accepts exactly one advisory in exactly the recorded dev-only dependency chain until its review deadline; anything else in the full audit fails the gate. A passing evaluation is a policy-based acceptance, NOT a clean npm audit: the full report keeps listing the accepted advisory. Production dependencies are audited separately with no exceptions (npm audit --omit=dev). See docs/reports/phase-6-ci-security-policy.md.

exceptions.title: minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification
exceptions.justification: Development tooling only: both vulnerable copies (minimatch 3.1.5 and 10.2.6) are reached only through ESLint 9, eslint-config-next and typescript-eslint, which lint the repository's own files with the repository's own config globs and never match untrusted patterns. npm audit --omit=dev reports 0, npm ls minimatch --omit=dev is empty and no minimatch code is in the production build. The only patched line is the new major minimatch 11.x (11.0.1 of 2026-10-27), outside every consumer's declared range (^3.1.x, ^10.2.x, including eslint 10.14.0); npm's own fix downgrades to eslint 4.0.0 / eslint-config-next 0.2.4, so neither npm audit fix --force nor an override is applied.
exceptions.approvedBy: Architectural review of docs/reports/phase-6-final-qa.md (temporary dev-only exception)
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade eslint, eslint-config-next and typescript-eslint (and @eslint/eslintrc, eslint-plugin-import, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, eslint-plugin-react) to releases that depend on minimatch >= 11.0.1, then delete this exception. If no such release exists by the deadline, the exception must be re-reviewed; it is not renewed automatically.
blockingConditions: any advisory other than GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, at any severity, in any dependency
any finding whose underlying advisory cannot be resolved to a GitHub advisory ID
any vulnerable node that is not dev-only in package-lock.json
GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 with a different severity, vulnerable range, CWE, npm source ID or title
any change to the vulnerable minimatch copies (node paths or installed versions)
any change to the set of dependent packages, their node paths or their direct/transitive status
the review deadline (end of 2026-11-30 UTC) has passed
a missing, malformed or incomplete policy, audit report or lockfile, or an npm audit execution failure
